components.css: .ds-project{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;font-family:Geist,Arial,sans-serif;transition:border-color .2s ease-out}.ds-project:hover{border-color:var(--input-line)}.ds-preview{aspect-ratio:16/9;background:var(--hover);border-radius:11px 11px 0 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--secondary)}.ds-info{padding:20px}.ds-info h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.025em}.ds-info a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-info a:hover{color:var(--text)}.ds-info a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--muted);outline-offset:5px}.ds-info p{margin:0 0 20px;color:var(--secondary);font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}

components.name: Technology tooltip
components.description: Source-colored technology mark with tooltip on hover or focus.
components.html: Technology
components.css: .ds-tech{position:relative;display:inline-flex;color:var(--text)}.ds-tech svg{transition:transform .15s ease-out}.ds-tech:hover svg{transform:scale(1.1)}.ds-tooltip{display:none;position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 14px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;background:#1e1e20;color:#f0f0f0;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;font:500 12.5px Geist,Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18);pointer-events:none}.ds-tooltip:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:100%;left:50%;margin-left:-5px;border:5px solid transparent;border-top-color:#1e1e20}.ds-tech:hover .ds-tooltip,.ds-tech:focus-visible .ds-tooltip{display:block}.ds-tech:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--muted);outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: A compact monochrome developer portfolio following the explicit siddz.com copy request. Geist typography, a narrow centered column, faint background grid, and uppercase mono labels define the implemented identity. Existing portfolio content remains unchanged.
dos: Preserve the reference composition and existing content.
Retain focus, skip-link, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not introduce an unrelated visual direction.
Do not replace the subtle grid or Geist typography.
Do not add heavy card shadows.
